setup: Ysmay holds Quicksilver (vow level 2, The Quicksilver Hall) and Ember (vow level 1, The Ember Court); picks Cut in Two, Bleeding Cut, Read the Feint (level 2, Quicksilver) and Cinder Step (level 1, Ember)

runs.label: a pick whose name contains the word in, taken as the pick
runs.output_raw: You take Cut in Two. Level 2: 1 of 4.
runs.output: You take Cut in Two. Level 2: 1 of 4.

runs.label: pick then a named covenant the character belongs to
runs.command: vow pick Bleeding Cut in The Quicksilver Hall
runs.output_raw: You take Bleeding Cut. Level 2: 4 of 4.
runs.output: You take Bleeding Cut. Level 2: 4 of 4.

runs.label: trailing in-phrase that names no covenant of hers is part of the pick name
runs.command: vow pick Read the Feint in Nowhere
runs.output_raw: Your vow offers no pick named Read the Feint in Nowhere.
runs.output: Your vow offers no pick named Read the Feint in Nowhere.
